The Parent Network

The Digital Media Empire of the New Era

House Of Wasila operates at the absolute center of cultural storytelling, commercial production, and high-fidelity broadcasting. As Pakistan's premier parent media house, we serve as the master architect behind a diverse digital media network engineered to command attention across global demographics.

Our expansive ecosystem controls seven specialized independent channels—broadcasting elite sports, analytical news, soul-enriching Islamic discussions, original music records, high-concept fictional narratives, and engaging kids education under a single, unified banner of absolute creative command.
